item.title: ZDI-26-1069: (0Day) BusyBox ftpd Directory Traversal Arbitrary File Read and Write Vulnerability
item.description: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create or delete arbitrary files or disclose sensitive information on affected installations of BusyBox. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The ZDI has assigned a CVSS rating of 6.5.

item.title: ZDI-26-1066: (0Day) Python Packaging Authority pip Configuration File Incorrect Permission Assignment Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
item.description: This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Python Packaging Authority pip. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. User interaction on the part of a target user is also required. The ZDI has assigned a CVSS rating of 7.3.

item.title: UK cyber agency, threat companies tracking rise in AI-assisted hacks
item.description: The National Cyber Security Centre said it is observing a “marked” increase in such attacks across sectors, as threat actors increasingly delegate to machines. The post UK cyber agency, threat companies tracking rise in AI-assisted hacks appeared first on CyberScoop .

item.title: CVE-2026-132224: Optimizely Web Experimentation
item.description: Optimizely Web Experimentation contains an external control of critical state data vulnerability in its account signup flow that could allow an attacker to impersonate existing customer users and modify Project JavaScript. Successful exploitation can result in attacker-controlled JavaScript being distributed through Optimizely-hosted assets and executed in browsers visiting affected customer websites.

item.title: CVE-2026-131914: Idunno AntiCsrf
item.description: Idunno AntiCsrf contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via object injection. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

item.title: CVE-2026-132165: Drupal Core
item.description: Drupal Core contains a not failing securely vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to take over an existing site or execute arbitrary code via the Drupal installer. Under specific conditions, the attacker can use install.php to attempt to reinstall Drupal on the site.
